item.tests: Clarifies the intended person in a two-person source before producing a single identity-preserving headshot.

answer_sheet.Which person: I'm the woman with short blonde hair on the right.
answer_sheet.Style and expression: Natural and professional; keep my smile.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: No particular platform; square, 640 × 640 is fine.

must_haves: The only person in the final portrait is the short-haired blonde woman from the right of two-friends.jpg.
Her face, short blonde hairstyle and smile remain recognisable from the source.
The man is entirely absent, including any partial face, shoulder or arm.
The beach setting and casual presentation are replaced with professional clothing and an unobtrusive backdrop.
The output is a square head-and-shoulders portrait with natural-looking lighting and no visible editing artifacts.
